title: 敬愛を抱きて誠意尽くすが礼

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: So these are my training exercises for this week? I see.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you're motivated to train on your own, but try not to overdo it.
I'm glad you're motivated to train on your own, but try not to overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Duly noted. I'm going to get changed now, and then I'll meet you on the field.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Hold on to me for support!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I'm all right. It's nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'll have to redo my taping so it's tighter.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Is it all right for you to be running while you're in pain?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. This level of pain is well within my threshold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm minding my limits carefully. I want to avoid the possibility of being rendered unable to race in the Japanese Derby at all costs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You don't have to worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm prepared to wager my very life at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And if I were to burn out, never to race again, so be it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Rather… I wish to burn out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If by burning up, I can cast a brilliant light that serves as proof that I existed, then I would gladly do just that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I dream of running with you, Chiyono O, and everyone else in a race so grand, its splendor shines on forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So please, you must focus on your own training.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Very well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I vow to give you a race that lives up to your conviction.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you for that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And thank you for listening to my request.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wish to use the Japanese Derby to leave a mark on the racing world that lasts, no matter the cost—just as my sister did.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Her legs were a source of much worry for her when she was young as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: However, she overcame that weakness and went on to become the first Triple Tiara champion in history.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The glory she won is so brilliant that she shines as the crown jewel of the Mejiro family even today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wish to shine just like she did, to leave tangible proof of my existence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: If I am to etch my name in perpetuity, then there's no honor more fitting than victory at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I must win the Derby, if nothing else!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki trains diligently without uttering a single word. Her hardened gaze exudes a determination that was absent from our meeting earlier.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'd like to do another lap. I felt that my acceleration was lacking.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, wheeze… Urk! Cough, hack!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… This isn't… good enough…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If I can't even run this distance without struggling, there's no way I can win a 2,400-meter race…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen entrusted her hopes to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have to try harder! Much, much, much harder! Until I break my limits!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There's no way I'll let anyone have the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win it for Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even at this distance, I can feel the sting of Chiyono O's spirit.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: She's like a wild wolf, determined to seize my throat and tear it asunder.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: She's so bent on attaining victory, she's willing to push past her body's limits with no concern for her well-being…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And Ardan is willing to quite literally put her life on the line, all for the sake of releasing a split second's worth of precious light…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Competing in the Japanese Derby is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, and both of them are staking everything for the chance to win.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But even though I'm aware of the dreams and determination they hold dear in their hearts, I will not back down.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall seize victory, even if it means I must shatter their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I hereby vow to face them with all that I have in honorable combat!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'd like to go on another run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps inspired by Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan, Yaeno Muteki's eyes starts to glow with a new, intense fire.
